mcp_tools.name: vfd_application_engineering_check
mcp_tools.title: VFD application engineering check
mcp_tools.description: Submit a declared VFD application manifest (application profile, power quality, motor/cable/drive records, protection and control, commissioning, troubleshooting, records and red lines); get a deterministic SOUND / NOT_SOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across seven sections, including computed declared-vs-declared harmonic-distortion, cable-length and derated-current checks, with per-check evidence. Declared values only; nothing is measured.

inputSchema.description: The VFD application manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table).

application.description: Application-profile evidence (load/torque type, duty, speed range, environment, selection to duty).

power_quality.description: Power-quality evidence (declared harmonic distortion vs the declared site limit, mitigation, capacitor interaction).

cable.description: Cable evidence (declared length vs the declared OEM maximum lead length).

drive.description: Drive evidence (declared derated current vs required load current, ratings, cooling).

troubleshooting.description: Troubleshooting evidence (checked when troubleshooting is declared open).

expect.notes: All fields present and valid. Computed margins: harmonic_margin_percent=1.5000, cable_margin_m=50.0000, current_margin_a=10.0000.
